programme.title: Ave sin nido
programme.desc: In this dramatic morality tale from Director Chano Urueto, a pretty young girl is torn between her religious faith and true love. She ultimately leaves the Convent and the nuns who cared for her, in order to marry a handsome and successful engineer. The couple's marital bliss is cut short when they find they cannot conceive children. After having an extramarital affair, the husband fathers a girl with the other woman. While hurt by his infidelity at first, this wife recovers and both soon realize that they could raise this baby as their own daughter, while allowing the biological mother to avoid the shame and stigma of having a child out of wedlock. This convenient solution seems as if it was tailor-made and heaven-sent. This mutually advantageous and seemingly harmless lie works out well through the years, as their daughter grows into a beautiful young woman in her own right. Just as she is about to marry her own true love, the poor girl finally discovers the awful truth. Consequently, she feels that she must now go live with her birth mother, especially after being lied to for so long by those who raised her. Worst of all, she is suddenly forced to come to grips with the fact that she is really an illegitimate child, born out of wedlock, as the result of an adulterous affair. As such, she now considers herself to be tainted and utterly unworthy to marry her intended, or anyone else, for that matter. The all-star cast includes Rene Cardona, David Silva and Jose Pulido.

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: The most prominent female painter of Latin America, Frida Kahlo, is agonizing in her Coyoacán home. She evokes memories of her childhood, of the streetcar accident that caused her terrible pain and affliction, her friendship with Trotsky and painter Alfaro Siqueiros, her marriage to Diego Rivera, her miscarriage, her political commitment, her love affairs and the anticipated exhibition of her works.

programme.desc: Alguien grafiteó la fachada del edificio. Para retirarlo, Germán cambia el número de la entrada. ¿Recibirá Luis el paquete que espera? ¿Acudirán a pintar el departamento de Lorena?

programme.title: Magdalena y la tercera edad
programme.desc: Magdalena descubre que las personas de tercera edad recibirán tarjetas de ayuda. La familia López Pérez intenta obtener el beneficio. A Luis le molesta que Benito tenga un auto nuevo.

programme.title: Cásate conmigo
programme.desc: Comienza una guerra tras la pelea entre Silvia y Luis, sin embargo él le pide matrimonio. Lorena le pide a Germán que arregle una mesa.

programme.title: La boda
programme.desc: Luis y Silvia anuncian su boda y los vecinos los convencerán para que se casen en el edificio y ayudarán a los preparativos.

programme.title: Vecinos ruidosos
programme.desc: Los vecinos se quejan de los ruidos que vienen del departamento de Luis y Silvita, Germán intenta reparar la tubería de Lorena y los López Pérez sufren de comezón.

programme.title: Frankie regresa
programme.desc: Frankie regresa a vivir al edificio, con Lorena y con Benito, pero con la condición de que encuentre trabajo. Pero, en vez de eso, escribirá una nueva película.

programme.title: La llegada de Vanesa
programme.desc: Vanesa vuelve al edificio para visitar a los Vecinos y ponerse al corriente. Benito invita a su novia a "ver pelis" en el departamento, al enterarse de que sus papás saldrán.

programme.title: La cocina de Silvita
programme.desc: Como Luis le ha preparado el desayuno, Silvita se encargará de prepararle a su esposo un platillo espectacular.

programme.title: El hojalatero
programme.desc: Al vecindario llega un mecánico, quien pondrá su taller en la calle justo afuera del edificio. Cris motivará a Pedro para que limpie el departamento por primera vez.

programme.title: La cosas de Don Roque
programme.desc: Germán le entrega a Vanessa cosas que le dejó don Roque, por lo que ambos lo recuerdan y homenajean. Lorena aprecia a Soledad, la nueva amiga de Benito.

programme.title: El tamalero
programme.desc: Como el tamalero no deja dormir a Luis, este le pedirá que le baje a su bocina. Ve cuántos enemigos se echará encima, por dejar sin trabajo al tamalero.

programme.title: Los paramédicos
programme.desc: Por pedirle a Morris que ponga en su tarea que son paramédicos, Rocko y Ale deben ir a la escuela a dar un curso de primeros auxilios. Llegan nuevos vecinos al departamento 301.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.desc: Bobby and friends explore Walmart sewers, catching and saving different fish species with nets and traps, discussing unique fish and the flooded area.

programme.desc: Bobby and team find various hidden aquatic creatures, including blue crawfish and African cichlids, while exploring green slime ponds.

programme.title: I Found a Hidden Tunnel FILLED with Rare Fish!
programme.desc: Returning to a fish-filled tunnel, Bobby undertakes a 24-hour trapping challenge, catching various fish, crawfish, and a mysterious giant shrimp-like creature.

programme.title: I Found a Hidden Tunnel FILLED with Rare Fish...
programme.desc: Bobby explores a flooded sewer, risking encounters with alligators and snakes, while setting traps to catch blue crawfish and other exotic fish for his backyard pond.

programme.title: I Caught the Monster Attacking My Fish!
programme.desc: Bobby rescues fish from his pond after discovering a 4-foot ripsaw catfish attacking them. Rehousing includes freshwater sharks, sturgeons, and exotic catfish.

programme.title: I Found Dolphins in an Abandoned Pool!
programme.desc: A mission to rescue fish, including a dolphin living in an abandoned pool infested with snakes. Various rare fish encountered and eventually rehomed.

programme.title: I Bought The Deadliest Insects (to keep as pets)
programme.desc: Bobby buys venomous insects and rare species to overcome his fear, encountering black widows, tarantulas, centipedes, and more, culminating in a room full of deadly pets.

programme.title: I Found a Secret Pond Full of Monsters!
programme.desc: Bobby explores secret ponds filled with rare, predatory, and dangerous fish, catching species like sturgeons, albino turtles, and vampire fish, valued at over $20,000.

programme.title: I Caught Rare Fish For My Aquarium!
programme.desc: Bobby shows the process of netting and trapping various fish from a creek to create a temporary fish tank ecosystem, later transferring them to his home aquarium.

programme.title: I Found a Monster Living in My Pond...
programme.desc: Bobby catches and relocates dangerous, rare, and massive fish from infested ponds to a new, larger pond, facing numerous challenges and surprises along the way.

programme.title: I Found a Pond Infested with Sharks!
programme.desc: Bobby and team rescue rare fish from a pond, relocating koi, catfish, and sharks to new homes before the pond is destroyed.

programme.title: I Bought The Deadliest Animals (to keep as pets)
programme.desc: Bobby buys deadly animals from the dark web, including venomous fish, spiders, and exotic pets. He then unboxes, identifies, and takes care of them.

programme.title: I Found a Monster Living in a Creepy Tunnel!
programme.desc: The team explores a tunnel and its connecting sewers, encountering various exotic fish, rare blue crawfish, and dangerous creatures like snakes and spiders.

programme.title: I Found a Dinosaur in an Abandoned Pond!
programme.desc: Bobby goes on a mission to rescue a giant African lungfish and other rare, aggressive fish from an abandoned pond with unexpected dangers and amazing discoveries.

programme.title: I Survived 24 Hours in Alligator INFESTED Water!
programme.desc: Bobby spent 24 hours in the Everglades, encountering gators, catching fish, and placing traps. Highlights include catching Oscars, Texas cichlids, fire eels, and rescuing a turtle.

programme.title: I Bought the RAREST Prehistoric Aquarium Fish!
programme.desc: Bobbby buys two rare, 350 million-year-old paddlefish for his backyard pond, with plans to transfer them to a larger pond as they grow.

programme.title: I Found Monsters Living in an Abandoned Pool!
programme.desc: Bobby and friends explore an abandoned pool filled with fish, catching and relocating them to a lake while reacting to the unexpected finds.

programme.title: Netting Wild EXOTIC FISH For My NEW AQUARIUM!
programme.desc: Bobby takes you on an exciting adventure to catch exotic fish and puffer fish for a new tank, overcoming leeches and discovering unique aquarium species.

programme.title: MeatEater Trivia Ep. 830 - S12
programme.desc: Spencer Neuharth hosts MeatEater Trivia with Doug Duren, Janis Putelis, Randall Williams, Seth Morris, Hanzi Deschermeier, and Reva Hansen.

programme.title: Is Trawling Destroying Alaska's Fisheries? | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 864
programme.desc: Topics discussed: The Stop Alaska Trawler Bycatch group; the incomprehensible size of trawling nets; pulling up a quarter of a million pounds of fish with one trawl net sweep; a floating factory; the impact of bottom trawling and how many countries have banned it; what you're really not supposed to be catching; as good as dead if caught in a trawl net; different regs between the Bering Sea and the Gulf of Alaska; population impacts on pollock, salmon, and many other species; the huge concern of the seafloor being destroyed and lost; and more.

programme.title: How To Start A Bison Ranch | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 874
programme.desc:
Steven Rinella talks with Matt Skoglund of North Bridger Bison.
Topics discussed: How you get from being a lawyer in Chicago to being a bison rancher in Montana; conservation herds vs. wild herds, and how there are very few wild bison; why do people actually think cattle ranching is more favorable?; the importance of private land bison herds; the grasslands crisis; connecting our food to conservation; and more.

programme.title: The Defeat of Coronado | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 861
programme.desc:
Steven Rinella talks with author Peter Stark.
Topics discussed: Peter's brand new book, The Lost Cities of El Norte: Coronado's Quest, the Unconquered West, and the Birth of American Indian Resistance; the psychological story of the Coronado Expedition; Coronado's traumatic brain injury; reconnaissance party explorations and first contact with tribes; a foundational moment for indigenous resistance; Coronado's failure; and more.

programme.title: Does Predator Management Actually Work? | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 877
programme.desc:
Steven Rinella talks with Mike Bodenchuk.
Topics discussed: Predator-prey dynamics; predator impact and wildlife management from a strategic removal perspective; predator snails; predation rates impacted by nearly a dozen factors; how coyote management is ineffective if not time-targeted after breeding pairs mate; controlling wolves by controlling pack size; how recreational hunting is absolutely insufficient at managing the wild hog population, but hunters shooting young sows can still be helpful; linear habitats; and more.

programme.title: Pod Save the World (Pentagon Covers Up Iran War Casualties)
programme.desc:
More US casualties in the war with Iran, the State Department's new neo-McCarthy Cuba blacklist, and the UK gets a new Prime Minister while CPAC Great Britain flops.
Tommy and Ben discuss reports that the Pentagon has been covering up the full extent of casualties associated with the war with Iran, the impact of the Houthi rebels potentially getting involved in the conflict, and Trump’s threat to bomb a new Iranian nuclear site. The State Department released a new report blaming everything Marco Rubio doesn’t like on Cuba, and the guys read it* so you don’t have to! (*skimmed it) Then they discuss the national security risk from prediction markets, Trump’s decision to slap new tariffs on Canada as its forests burn, and new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s first days in office. Finally, the guys take you to the first CPAC Great Britain, and discuss Count Binface’s deep-space bid to defeat Nigel Farage. Then Tommy speaks to Oleksiy Sorokin, Deputy Chief Editor for the Kyiv Independent, about the latest barrage of Russian ballistic missile strikes and protests in Ukraine over Zelensky’s military staffing decisions.

programme.title: What a Day (Iran: Trump's Forever War?)
programme.desc:
Over the weekend, the Pentagon announced that three US service members were killed as fighting intensified between the US and Iran. That brings the current death toll for US military personnel engaged in the war to 17. And with news from the New York Times that the Pentagon has been hesitant to share more information about further casualties. It's clear that the Iran war is far from ending, and may even be spiraling out of control. So to talk more about Trump's war of choice, we spoke with Mehdi Hasan. He's the editor-in-chief and CEO of Zeteo.
And in headlines, US senators are pushing for more details about ICE's vetting practices for new agents, Troy Jackson, a fifth-generation logger, is almost certain to become the Democratic Senate nominee in Maine, and President Trump tries to steal the spotlight from Spain after the FIFA World Cup final.

programme.title: Keep It (One Odyssey To Rule Them All)
programme.desc: Louis and Nina deep dive into Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey,” play a “What Would You Do” game about seat snatching in a packed theater, and discuss their favorite movies from “The Odyssey” ‘s star studded cast. Plus, the two get into Andy Serkis’s all white adaptation of the “Lord of The Rings.”

programme.title: Assembly Required with Stacey Abrams (The Real(ish) History of America)
programme.desc: America has an infamously imperfect past, but rather than confronting our demons, interpretations of our history have become a political football. This week, Stacey is joined by historian and author Heather Cox Richardson, and award winning journalist and member of the Cherokee nation, Rebecca Nagle. They talk about where America stands 250 years in, why erasing native history is so damaging, and how the way we frame our past shapes our civil discourse today.

programme.title: Ave sin nido
programme.desc: In this dramatic morality tale from Director Chano Urueto, a pretty young girl is torn between her religious faith and true love. She ultimately leaves the Convent and the nuns who cared for her, in order to marry a handsome and successful engineer. The couple's marital bliss is cut short when they find they cannot conceive children. After having an extramarital affair, the husband fathers a girl with the other woman. While hurt by his infidelity at first, this wife recovers and both soon realize that they could raise this baby as their own daughter, while allowing the biological mother to avoid the shame and stigma of having a child out of wedlock. This convenient solution seems as if it was tailor-made and heaven-sent. This mutually advantageous and seemingly harmless lie works out well through the years, as their daughter grows into a beautiful young woman in her own right. Just as she is about to marry her own true love, the poor girl finally discovers the awful truth. Consequently, she feels that she must now go live with her birth mother, especially after being lied to for so long by those who raised her. Worst of all, she is suddenly forced to come to grips with the fact that she is really an illegitimate child, born out of wedlock, as the result of an adulterous affair. As such, she now considers herself to be tainted and utterly unworthy to marry her intended, or anyone else, for that matter. The all-star cast includes Rene Cardona, David Silva and Jose Pulido.
